name: avvillas.com.co
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 1 internal link leads to an error.
lesson: Check your own links after each release, and fix or redirect every one that answers 404.
summary: www.avvillas.com.co scores 57 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 34 are at risk, and 25 pass. Fix first: 92 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 92 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /productos-en-oficina, /inversionistas, /alianzas/ and 85 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /productos-en-oficina, /empresas, for example #close-button. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 9 elements on /, /productos-en-oficina, /empresas, for example .icon-chatbot-n and .icon-location-n. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 8 elements on /productos-en-oficina, /empresas, for example .avv-stickymenu__item[aria-hidden="true"]:nth-child(1) and .avv-stickymenu__item[aria-hidden="true"]:nth-child(2). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Remove focusable elements from aria-hidden containers, or drop aria-hidden.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Google Analytics (4 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), Adobe Analytics (1 request), and cookies _hjSessionUser_2877411, _hjSession_2877411, _ga, _ga_none, _gcl_au,…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
HSTS is sent with a long max-age
The start page declares its language
The layout holds still while loading
Language alternates point at each other
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
